headlines: Chip rout deepens: NVDA -5.5%, AMD -12%, MU -10.5%, SNDK -14%, SOXL -22.7%, QQQ -3.8% on Stocktwits trending
Tech bulls divided: Tom Lee expects a 20% tech rally after the midterms, Dan Ives warns of more downside (Stocktwits news)
US nonfarm payrolls due tomorrow 13:30 UTC (prior 29); ADP 86 vs 90 and ISM services 54.5 vs 54.9 came out yesterday

rumors.text: Posters blame the Democratic midterm win for expected limits on the AI buildout and say the AI trade will keep cracking
rumors.why: If policy fears persist, AI-heavy index weights keep dragging SPY and QQQ

rumors.text: Tom Lee reportedly expects a 20% tech rally, saying a divided Washington reduces pressure on the Fed
rumors.why: A dip-buying narrative from a followed strategist could support a bounce, but it is a forecast not a fact

rumors.text: Dan Ives warns of more downside in tech, though other reports say he downplays the selloff
rumors.why: Conflicting accounts; if he did turn cautious it could extend the chip drop

plays.reason: Crowd is bearish and capitulating, QQQ 5-min RSI near 4, SPY down 1.15% so a partial bounce into payrolls is plausible
plays.catalyst: Oversold chip bounce vs tomorrow's payrolls

readings.whats_new: The chip selloff has turned into a broad slide: SPY is -1.15% and QQQ about -2.9% to -3.8%, versus SPY +0.14% last reading. Fear and greed rose to about 35 and VIX is steady near 17, while Stocktwits SPY sentiment dropped to 33. Reddit was blocked.
